import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import os

# Set random seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Create target labels for training
train_labels = ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]

# Vectorizer
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=5000, ngram_range=(1, 2))

# Fit vectorizer on training texts
X_train_texts = train_df["text"].astype(str)
X_test_texts = test_df["text"].astype(str)
X_train = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_texts)
X_test = vectorizer.transform(X_test_texts)

# Split training data for hold-out validation (genuine estimate)
X_train_full, X_val, y_train_full, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train,
    train_df["author"],
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=train_df["author"],
)

# Train model on full training set
model = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, solver="lbfgs", C=1.0)
model.fit(X_train_full, y_train_full)

# Predictions on validation (for scoring)
y_val_pred_prob = model.predict_proba(X_val)


# For log loss calculation on validation
def compute_log_loss(y_true, y_pred):
    eps = 1e-15
    probs = np.clip(y_pred, eps, 1 - eps)
    total_loss = 0
    n_classes = len(train_labels)
    for i in range(len(y_true)):
        for j in range(n_classes):
            y_ij = 1 if y_true.iloc[i] == train_labels[j] else 0
            total_loss += y_ij * np.log(probs[i, j])
    return -total_loss / len(y_true)


log_loss_val = compute_log_loss(
    pd.DataFrame({"id": list(range(len(y_val)))}).set_index("id").index, y_val_pred_prob
).mean()

# Predictions on test set
y_test_pred = model.predict_proba(X_test)

# Create submission dataframe
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_df["id"],
        "EAP": y_test_pred[:, 0],
        "HPL": y_test_pred[:, 1],
        "MWS": y_test_pred[:, 2],
    }
)

# Save submission
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"Evaluation Metric (Multi-class Log Loss on Validation): {log_loss_val:.6f}")
